note: THE DEDUP RULE, DECLARED AS DATA — ordered by RULING P0b-R2 (SABLE_RIVER, 2026-08-17): 'Declare the dedup rule as DATA in the plugin, in the exact terms of the table below — never inherit one by accident.' syntheticTier: EXCLUDED from JUDGMENT scope, on two independent grounds: the supervisor's round-trip scope limit, and CARDINAL_MEADOW's measurement that the 522 synthetic declarations add ZERO distinct concepts in this key space.
THE_SEAM_P0b_FOUND: Which effective description a concept gets DEPENDS ON WHICH EDGES YOU COUNT, and four defensible rules over one corpus give four different populations. A bridge dedupping over the FINAL graph sees 2,213 groups whose members were EMBEDDED at a grain that would have counted 2,347. Neither is wrong; they answer different questions. 2,213 STANDS — a builder does not re-rule a TQ scope decision because a better-fitting grain appeared downstream. All four figures are recorded here so THE NEXT BUILDER CHOOSES RATHER THAN DISCOVERS.

THE_CAVEAT_THAT_MUST_TRAVEL: Recording the pool with the fan-out makes it AUDITABLE; it does not make it CORRECT. A dedup group can contain MORE THAN ONE DISTINCT EMBEDDED TEXT, and the lowest-stableId representative SILENTLY DECIDES WHICH VECTOR THE WHOLE GROUP RETRIEVES ON. P0b measured that within-group variation as SYSTEMATIC rather than incidental (369 of 2,222 groups carry more than one distinct searchText). THE REPRESENTATIVE'S POOL IS A CHOICE THE DATA MADE FOR US, NOT A PROPERTY OF THE GROUP.
whereThePoolIsRecorded: The framework ALREADY records it: decisionBlock.js:65 ships renderedPoolStableIdList / filteredPoolStableIdList / keyPoolStableIdList as decision-record fields. So P0b-R2's pool requirement costs ZERO and needs no new mechanism. Only the GROUP ENUMERATION needed a home, and that is pescDerivedConceptFanOut.json.
whyTheGraphCarries2213EdgesAndNot16969: RULING P1-R3 (SABLE_RIVER, 2026-08-17), on principle rather than cost: 16,969 edges derived from 2,213 judgments would put 16,969 assertions in the graph backed by 2,213 acts of judgment, and a consumer counting edges would read that as 16,969 pieces of evidence. THE GRAPH SHOULD CARRY WHAT WAS ACTUALLY JUDGED, AND EXPANSION SHOULD BE AN EXPLICIT, AUDITABLE OPERATION RATHER THAN A SILENT MULTIPLICATION BAKED INTO THE ARTIFACT. Whether the DELIVERED graph should eventually carry an edge per occurrence is on the after-PESC docket WITH its price stated (a materialiser change, therefore a framework change), and it is TQ's.
